_meta.purpose: Named-function map of the Mercenaries 2 (PC, Mercenaries2.exe, image_base=0x00400000) WAD/asset-load, chunk-parse, streaming and allocator code path. Reusable 'base-truth' index.
_meta.schema: Object mapping "0x<ADDR>" -> {name, role, confidence(high|med|low), phase, callers[], callees[], evidence}. This is the schema requested by the function-map task. NOTE: scripts/ghidra_mercs2_annotate.py consumes a DIFFERENT schema (top-level keys known_vas/string_database/lua_registrations/rtti_patterns built by ghidra_mercs2_preanalysis.py). This file is intentionally the function-map schema, not the annotate.py input. To label these in Ghidra, a small adapter should emit known_vas:[{va,name,type:'load_path',comment:role}] from this object.
_meta.scope: WAD/INDX read -> sges/decompress -> block/entry table -> UCFX/chunk-tree deserialize -> per-type consumers (mesh/material/texture/layer/descriptor) -> streaming manager/worker -> allocators. Boundary functions to unrelated subsystems are noted but not recursed into.

data_anchors.0x019f9044: stream ring table ptr A (small/0x400-entry pimpQueue)
data_anchors.0x019f9048: stream ring table ptr B (mid/0x1000-entry pimpQueue)
data_anchors.0x019f904c: job-type dispatch table (handler fnptr per job-type id, stride 8)

0x0084af70.name: Stream_InitPools
0x0084af70.role: Streaming subsystem init: builds 3 mutex-guarded 'pimpQueue' job rings (0x400/0x1000/0x10 entries, entry sizes 0x60), wires ring table ptrs DAT_019f9044/48
0x0084af70.evidence: string 's_pimpQueue_00be33c4' used as mutex name; writes _DAT_019f9044/_DAT_019f9048 ring anchors at end

0x00876400.name: Stream_WorkerThread
0x00876400.role: Streaming worker/job-dispatch loop: pops ring work items from DAT_019f9044/48, dispatches via job table DAT_019f904c[type*8], InterlockedExchangeAdd completion counter, Sleep(0) when idle
0x00876400.evidence: seed; param_1*300 ring stride, dispatch '(*pcVar5)(piVar7[2])' via &DAT_019f904c+type*8

0x004c00e0.name: Stream_SubmitJob_Init
0x004c00e0.role: Registers a job-type handler (LAB_004c00c0, id=0) then enqueues an init work item into the 0x400 pimpQueue ring (head/tail at DAT_00ff45f8), and installs ~60 subsystem singleton ptrs
0x004c00e0.evidence: classic ring-push (memcpy into DAT_00ff45f4 at computed slot, advance DAT_00ff45f8) guarded by CS DAT_00ff4600

0x008739e0.name: Stream_Manager_Tick
0x008739e0.role: Streaming manager completion/eviction gate: walks resident lists @+0x818/+0x828, checks (*(node+0x30))(level)==4 completion, sizes via node+0x4c, recycles finished nodes into ring @+0x3ffe8

0x00872d30.name: Stream_Manager_Update
0x00872d30.role: Top streaming-manager update: optionally flushes (0x872e60), runs the completion tick (0x8739e0) and the retry/promote pass (0x873cf0), sets busy flag @+0x4c35c

0x008738f0.name: Stream_EvictCompleted
0x008738f0.role: Eviction stage: walks list @+0x828, frees finished stream nodes (releases node[0x18] body + node[0xe] header via 0x84acd0), decrements resident-byte counter @+0x4c368
0x008738f0.evidence: frees per-class buffers, dec resident count by node[0x14]

0x00873cf0.name: Stream_RetryPromoteQueue
0x00873cf0.role: Retry/promote pass: walks pending queue @+0x20f, ages nodes (node[0xd] attempt counter), QueryPerformanceCounter timestamps, re-queues or completes, moves to ring @+0xfffa
0x00873cf0.evidence: attempt-count promotion logic with QPC timing

0x00872e60.name: Stream_ForceFlush
0x00872e60.role: Force/blocking flush of a stream queue (drives manager when count @+0x4c36c > 0)
0x00872e60.evidence: called before tick when backlog present

0x00875760.name: Stream_Node_Submit
0x00875760.role: Streaming target/node submit entry: resolves per-thread slot, computes node record (node+0x10) and pushes onto a producer ring; top of the node-producer chain

0x00873410.name: Stream_Node_Produce
0x00873410.role: Pops a node from ring @+0x3ffe8 and initializes it via Stream_Node_Init (0x8759c0); sets resident flags @node+0x36

0x008759c0.name: Stream_Node_Init
0x008759c0.role: Streaming target/node producer: copies source descriptor fields into a fresh node (node[+0x5A]=src[+0xA], handle/dims/flags), zeroes runtime fields

0x008743c0.name: Stream_Node_Unlink
0x008743c0.role: Unlinks a stream node from its intrusive list (helper for produce/evict)
0x008743c0.evidence: small list-splice helper shared by 0x873410 and 0x874410

0x00874410.name: Stream_Node_Recycle
0x00874410.role: Returns a completed/cancelled stream node to its free pool (shared by tick/retry/evict)
0x00874410.evidence: called immediately before 0x875a50 at every completion site

0x00875a50.name: Stream_Node_Finalize
0x00875a50.role: Finalizes a recycled stream node (paired with 0x874410 at all completion sites)

0x00873140.name: Stream_Resource_Acquire
0x00873140.role: Acquires/locks a streamable resource handle (double EnterCriticalSection on DAT_01174ffc, hash lookup 0x874150, sets state @+0x14 to 4/streamed)
0x00873140.evidence: state machine on resource+0x14 (0/3/4) under CS

0x008731f0.name: Stream_Resource_LookupOrCreate
0x008731f0.role: Resource-handle table lookup-or-create (hash via 0x8242b0(0x100), vtable construct)
0x008731f0.evidence: hash-table probe then vcall +0xc to construct

0x004c0ec0.name: Loader_Frame
0x004c0ec0.role: Loader frame wrapper: calls the loading-screen frame loop (0x4c9740) then ticks a sub-state

0x004c9740.name: LoadingScreen_FrameLoop
0x004c9740.role: Loading-screen per-frame pump: advances dozens of subsystems, drives Stream_Manager_Update (0x872d30) when load-stage>2; the main world-load driver frame
0x004c9740.evidence: seed; calls 0x872d30 gated on load stage @DAT_01175cdc+0x30>2

0x0067a7fa.name: Chunk_DeserializeMANM
0x0067a7fa.role: Chunk-tree deserializer (class vtable PTR_FUN_00bcdb70): dispatches MANM(0x4d4e414d)/info(0x6f666e69) sub-chunks, decompresses payload via 0x956d90, builds FNV-1a name->id table (0x811c9dc5/0x1000193 hash)
0x0067a7fa.evidence: MANM magic 0x4d4e414d, FNV-1a constants, memcpy of decompressed body to this+0x20

0x004cf340.name: Chunk_DeserializeCHDR
0x004cf340.role: Generic chunk-tree deserializer (class vtable 0xBB12B4): switch over CHDR/NODE/CECE/INFO/STAT magics building a nested {property,count,array} tree; the world-load 0x4CF58B AV site (NULL inner-array write)
0x004cf340.evidence: seed; magics CHDR 0x52444843, NODE 0x45444f4e, CECE 0x45584543, INFO 0x4f464e49, STAT 0x54415453; CHDR property-hash 0x9da9706 5/0xdb410 17d (-0x62568f9b/-0x24befe83)

0x00464780.name: Chunk_GetEntryReader
0x00464780.role: GetChunkDataReader: bounds-checks entry index (in_EAX), returns a 0x14-byte stride entry reader at this+0x18 (read cursor +0x10, end +0x14, base +0x18) with vtable refresh
0x00464780.evidence: seed; entry stride 0x14, bounds vs this+0x8; called by every chunk consumer

0x00825dc0.name: Chunk_ReadCString
0x00825dc0.role: Reads a length-prefixed/NUL-terminated string from the chunk stream into caller buffer (wraps 0x4fe43a)
0x00825dc0.evidence: called with (&buf,0x100) before FNV hashing in name-table loops

0x00956d20.name: Mesh_ComputePackedSize
0x00956d20.role: Computes packed/serialized size of a mesh body (sums per-submesh vertex/index spans, 0x30-byte record overhead, +0x20 header)

0x00956d90.name: Mesh_RelocateBody
0x00956d90.role: Mesh body serializer/relocator: writes magic 0xd5109142 header, lays out 0x30-byte submesh records, memcpys vert/index/extra spans, applies pointer-relocation tables and a fixup vcall
0x00956d90.evidence: magic 0xd5109142, three memcpys per submesh, reloc fixup loops

0x00478120.name: MeshLOD_ReadChunks
0x00478120.role: Mesh/LOD chunk-reader root: iterates child chunks feeding the per-type handler 0x478270

0x00478270.name: Mesh_ConsumeChunk
0x00478270.role: Mesh sub-chunk consumer: dispatches STRM(vert-stream), IBUF(index buf), BSHI/BSHP(blendshape), PRMT(primitive), AREA, INFO(header: counts, allocs blendshape/prim/material arrays via 0x84ac20)
0x00478270.evidence: magics STRM 0x4d525453, AREA 0x41455241, IBUF 0x46554249, BSHI 0x49485342, BSHP 0x50485342, PRMT 0x544d5250, INFO 0x4f464e49

0x004796f0.name: MeshSkin_ConsumeChunk
0x004796f0.role: Skinned-mesh sub-chunk consumer: INFO(0x38 header)/IBUF/BSHI/BSHP/STRM/PRMT; allocates index+blendshape arrays via 0x84ac20
0x004796f0.evidence: same magic set as 0x478270, INFO header size 0x38

0x004a4770.name: VertStream_ConsumeSTRM
0x004a4770.role: STRM (vertex stream) sub-chunk consumer: handles data(0x61746164 -> body ptr via 0x752890), decl(0x6c636564 -> vertex declaration via 0x752b30), info(0x6f666e69 -> stream desc via 0x7524a0)
0x004a4770.evidence: sub-magics data/decl/info; decl handler 0x752b30 == vertex-decl path

0x004a48f0.name: IndexBuf_ConsumeIBUF
0x004a48f0.role: IBUF (index buffer) sub-chunk consumer: info(0x6f666e69 -> count) then data(0x61746164 -> memcpy index data into GPU buffer from 0x751fd0; honors 16-bit/32-bit flag bit9)
0x004a48f0.evidence: data/info sub-magics; memcpy of count*stride into locked buffer

0x0074d6d0.name: VertDecl_ValidateClamp
0x0074d6d0.role: Vertex-declaration validator/clamp (declared seed; sanitizes element counts/types of decoded vertex decls)

0x00752890.name: VertStream_SetBody
0x00752890.role: Sets a vertex-stream body pointer on the stream object (STRM/data handler callee)
0x00752890.evidence: called from STRM data arm with body ptr

0x00752b30.name: VertDecl_Set
0x00752b30.role: Installs the decoded vertex declaration on the stream (STRM/decl handler callee; ties into validator 0x74d6d0)

0x004a4c40.name: Model_ConsumeChunks
0x004a4c40.role: Model/renderable chunk consumer root (__fastcall): iterates child chunks dispatching STRM/IBUF/MTRL and INFO header; container that owns the MTRL material parse

0x004a5230.name: Renderable_ConsumeChunk
0x004a5230.role: Per-renderable sub-chunk consumer: STRM(0x4a4770)+vertex-decl probe, IBUF(0x4a48f0), MTRL(0x4c52544d -> Mtrl_Parse 0x858790), INFO(0x14 header). Sets fallback material vtable @+0x1c4
0x004a5230.evidence: MTRL magic 0x4c52544d directly preceding call to 0x858790

0x004a8f30.name: Renderable_ConsumeChunk_Mtrl2
0x004a8f30.role: Renderable sub-chunk consumer that parses INFO + MTRL (calls Mtrl_Parse 0x858790)

0x004ac8e0.name: Renderable_ConsumeChunk_Mtrl3
0x004ac8e0.role: Renderable sub-chunk consumer parsing INFO + MTRL (caller of Mtrl_Parse 0x858790)

0x004a0c40.name: Renderable_ConsumeChunk_Mtrl0
0x004a0c40.role: Renderable sub-chunk consumer (two call sites into Mtrl_Parse 0x858790; primary material consumer)

0x00858790.name: Mtrl_Parse
0x00858790.role: MTRL material chunk parser: reads transform/UV floats and a u16 texture-count @offset 106, fills a fixed 10-slot {hash,0xF011157A,0} array @material+0xac. Blanket-u32-swap of this u16 count caused the 0x84DD5B world-load AV (fixed in converter)

0x00750a30.name: Tex_ConsumeChunk
0x00750a30.role: Texture chunk consumer: NAME(0x454d414e -> name string) and INFO(0x4f464e49 -> 0x3c-byte header: width/height/mip/format @ +4..+0x2e, surface-array size/flags); the texture-header parser at the heart of the DXT mip-count work
0x00750a30.evidence: BODY+INFO magics, NAME 0x454d414e; sequential u16/u32 reads into tex header fields (w/h/mip/fmt)

0x00492af0.name: Descriptor_ConsumeATRB
0x00492af0.role: ATRB (attribute/descriptor) chunk consumer: reads ATRB(0x42525441) sub-chunks then dispatches on a 32-bit property-hash id to per-property setters (thunks into 0x24exxx system layer)
0x00492af0.evidence: ATRB magic 0x42525441 then large switch over property hashes (0x70653182, 0x1de5c824, ...)

0x0046a440.name: Tex_RegisterStreamJobs
0x0046a440.role: Texture-streaming job registrar: installs 6 job-type handlers (LAB_0046a210..0046a320) into the job table DAT_019f904c with FourCC ids (0xcb414134, 0x5d9a2c1a, 0x5f2080d1, 0x17d1eda3, 0xe4fbf71f, 0x156bbfa2); seeds DAT_00e90b00 table

0x00489dd0.name: Render_RegisterStreamJobs
0x00489dd0.role: Render-resource job registrar: installs job-type handlers incl. the chunk-alloc callback 0x84ac00 and decode callbacks 0x82c100/0x8780d0/0x82d040/0x724cc0/0x724480/0x724c20

0x00402e90.name: Core_RegisterAllocJob
0x00402e90.role: Registers the base allocator job handler (FUN_004036b0) into the job table

0x0084ac20.name: Chunk_Alloc
0x0084ac20.role: Primary load-time allocator: __thiscall(size, poolIdx?) -> tries fast pool 0x84dce0 then slow pool 0x84d760, under CS DAT_00ff4570; the allocator behind every chunk-parse FUN_0084ac20 call
0x0084ac20.evidence: size-class table &DAT_00ff458c, CS DAT_00ff4570, both pool allocators as callees

0x0084d760.name: Pool_AllocSlow
0x0084d760.role: Slow/large block allocator (__stdcall poolDesc,size,rounded): falls back here when the fast freelist is empty; wraps 0x84d7b0 + 0x54420c

0x0084dce0.name: Pool_AllocFast
0x0084dce0.role: Fast pool allocator (__fastcall sizeHint): size-class freelist pop from DAT_00dfd108 slab array, updates per-bucket occupancy histogram and timing counters

0x0088cb70.name: SmallObj_PoolAlloc

0x0084acd0.name: Chunk_Free

0x008242b0.name: HashTable_Probe
0x008242b0.role: Generic open-addressing hash-table lookup (key,tableSize): linear-probe over u32 slots at unaff_ESI, returns slot index or 0xFFFFFFFF; used for chunk-property/handle resolution

0x00401860.name: Array_InitStride
0x00401860.role: Array constructor: zero/placement-inits N elements of a given stride (often w/ ctor LAB ptr); used to build chunk record arrays after Chunk_Alloc
0x00401860.evidence: called as FUN_00401860(ptr,stride,count[,ctor]) right after FUN_0084ac20 in 0x4cf340/0x478270/0x4796f0

0x0088f880.name: Mesh_AlignSize
0x0088f880.evidence: called to round vertex-region size in 0x956d20

0x0046b590.name: TexLoader_BuildResource
0x0046b590.role: Texture/resource loader: large builder (3.4KB) that reads name+header, allocates GPU resource, wires it into the resource table; entry from 0x74dc10
